title: Applicability of the Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program
previewText: For the purposes of applying the Inclusionary Housing Program provisions set forth in Section 27-10 (ADMINISTRATION OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING), inclusive, Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas within the Special Downtown Jamaica District are shown on the maps in APPENDIX F of this Resolution.
